# Original calibration estimator observations

These files are unchanged original-only observations from [Actions run 39537326538](https://github.com/bin9208/openpilot-rust/actions/runs/39537326538), job 119016882232, artifact 12317567332. The one-time diagnostic workflow head was `a315dfb64262eba511a4e2e968bce8dee5705a4b`; its pinned checkout was `04ee2c46963a27cbc9d37cea524f169a63557913`. The original-only driver SHA256 was `5586440182d7c7abb62706f05175f5cd3e4d61815b6ba289eb510fff7af4ce0f`. It called `histories()` and loaded the original `calibrationd.py` class through `calibration_reference.original()`. No Rust candidate ran during capture.

The public artifact ZIP SHA256 is `538a6a31ebe38654893e5e3b14a022900e76b4a48e0e26fe18dd0ba01bf3a6cf`. `manifest.json` SHA256 is `25b8e9a371542b159a90f4b9f1e81e2ea2ea925021c8c75be6c3bd88378d9362`; `original.jsonl.gz` SHA256 is `2404a796dc09886770546197417d325d53aa2f1d451722982bf7f319439ce954`. It contains 15,128 ordered requests, 15,098 full state/packet observations, 30 source errors, and 14 saved Params packet writes. The manifest pins all original code/schema sources and package versions. The compressed file is retained byte-for-byte from the artifact; it is independent expected data, not a native-produced reference.

The Rust test sends those exact requests to a freshly built `calibration_trace` ELF. It compares every state and complete decoded Event with the historical `2e-12` Float64 policy and one adjacent Float32 value (with the original `2e-12` cancellation floor) for packet float lists. Discrete fields, packet structure, validity, timestamp, accepted position, errors, and persistence position are exact. Captured saved packet contents are compared against the native publication packet after applying the original saved Event header (`logMonoTime=0`, `valid=true`). This verifies the contents proposed for persistence; `calibration_trace` exposes a persistence flag rather than performing a Params write. The test is a host estimator comparison, not a device or daemon lifecycle acceptance result.
